text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One felt inwardly indignant when her 
classmates misunderstood, thinking she had 
transferred because her talent was too big 
for the regional circuit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I refuse to let anyone claim regional 
Umamusume are inferior to the Central 
circuit. Yet, even if I were to say so 
now, no one would lend an ear.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"That's why she aims to become so big that 
no one can ignore her words, and declare 
to the world that the local circuits are 
not inferior to the Central."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aiming toward Inari One's new goal, her 
Junior Class warrior journey was about to 
begin.
